svg.aria-label: An itinerary strip chart of the road from Stanbyl to Svidsvikov, 115 leagues, drawn as a scroll in the manner of an old road atlas.

g.text: The ROAD from STANBYL to SVIDSVIKOV
in The Tsardom of Gyksvu · containing 115 leagues
as it was measured by the wayfarers' chain in the year 575
CHART № 15 · THE QUIET ISLES OF TRI
